test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Union Territories has a legislative assembly?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Delhi.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The National Capital Territory of Delhi has a legislative assembly and council of ministers.**
 
• At present, it consists of 70 members, directly elected from 70 constituencies.
 
• **Delhi, officially the National Capital Territory of Delhi (NCT), is a city and a union territory of India** containing New Delhi, the capital of India.

 
• Delhi elects 7 members and they are directly elected by the state electorates of Delhi. Members are elected for a term of five years.
 
• The number of seats, allocated to the state/union territory is determined** by the population of the state/union territory.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• ​**Union Territories without legislature**

 
 
• Andaman and Nicobar Islands
 
• Chandigarh
 
• Dadra and Nagar Haveli
 
• Daman and Diu
 
• Lakshadweep
 
• Ladakh
 
 
 
• 
 **Union Territories with the legislature:**

 
 
• National Capital Territory of Delhi
 
• Puducherry
 
• Jammu and Kashmir
